mechanisms.name: Volatility clustering processes
mechanisms.question: What processes cause volatility clustering?
mechanisms.hypothesis: High-vol states persist partly because leverage stress and liquidity withdrawal co-occur with high RV and prolong uncertainty.

mechanisms.name: Leverage build and unwind
mechanisms.question: How does leverage build and unwind?
mechanisms.hypothesis: Funding, premium and OI form a leverage cycle linked to subsequent vol and risk-off.

mechanisms.name: Liquidity creation, transfer, destruction
mechanisms.question: How is liquidity created, transferred and destroyed?
mechanisms.hypothesis: Mint/burn and venue flows change risk-bearing capacity; contractions amplify uncertainty.

mechanisms.name: Participant behaviour under uncertainty
mechanisms.question: How do market participants change behaviour during uncertainty?
mechanisms.hypothesis: High RV coincides with lower intensity, changed aggression, wider basis.

mechanisms.name: Cross-market information propagation
mechanisms.question: How does information propagate across markets?
mechanisms.hypothesis: Shocks transmit with lags across assets, venues and spot/perp.

mechanisms.name: Persistent market dislocations
mechanisms.question: What mechanisms explain persistent venue dislocations?
mechanisms.hypothesis: Inventory and USD/USDT rails sustain basis; stress widens absolute basis.

note: Properties are instruments. Mechanisms are the scientific objects. Nulls retire families.
